lead_independence.headline: Jury selected in bid-tampering trial of former Fort Pierce city manager
lead_independence.lead: Jury selection was completed Monday in the trial of former Fort Pierce City Manager Nicholas Mimms, who was arrested in August 2024 on charges of bid tampering and official misconduct related to a Lincoln Park lease scandal. Judge Michael Lynn oversaw the process at the St. Lucie County Courthouse, where 60 potential jurors were considered. Several individuals were not selected because they either knew Mimms, had worked with him, or cited medical or financial hardships.

rejected.headline: Vero Beach parking fines double Wednesday, with fire lane violations rising to $60

lead_independence.headline: Vero Beach parking fines double Wednesday, with fire lane violations rising to $60
lead_independence.lead: Vero Beach parking fines increase Wednesday, with most penalties doubling from rates set in 2011. The Vero Beach Police Department announced the changes Sunday and urged drivers to review the updated schedule before it takes effect Oct. 1.
